title: 9 Times a Godly Man Prays the Same Way Whether Anyone's Listening
caption:
9 times a godly man prays the same way whether anyone's listening or not.

Not just when the small group is watching.

Grace before a meal alone, not just at the family table. The quiet thank you before you text anyone else. Confession in the car, not just at the altar call. The Lord is near the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit (Psalm 34:18).

Consistency is the whole point. That's what makes it real.
